Name: (CP) Dacar Rasmodia anime style portraits (RRRR patch compatible)
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
Rasmodia's portraits are finally here! It includes one for SVE, non SVE, RomRas and RRRR!
It also includes an option to remove Rasmodia's hat! Why? Cause I like how it ended up looking basically. 
This works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18144]RRRR Rasmodia patch[/url] by default﻿, if you have it installed it will change to those portraits automatically!

This mod also has a Wedding Reception protrait available [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31890]here[/url]!

[color=#00ff00][b]-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**--Instructions for 1.6 CP for Portaiture--*
Just download the mod and put it in the mods folder.
In order to see the portraits you'll need Portraiture and do one of this two things:

-Once inside the game press "P" (by default it may be different depending on your settings) until you see HDP

-In Portraiture config setting  change this to not have to cycle through your portraits:
"active": "HDP" 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/b][/color]
